chapter: Tulsa bands, Trent, Holder and Kirk
title: T. Holder at the Louvre Ballroom in Tulsa
summary: T. Holder's band plays taxi dances at the Louvre, later renamed Kane's Ballroom; Love notes Holder and Trent as great southwest bands.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Alphonso Trent was watching and we came on back to Tulsa and then about that time T. Holder was around. T. Holder was at the Louvre Ballroom and of course T. Holder--I think they were doing the taxi dance in there.
It's now--they changed the name later on, a dance teacher took it over--Kane, they changed it to Kane's Ballroom.
Now, T. Holder and Alphonso Trent were two of the great southwest bands.
